versions.rationale: No skill content changed. All four files match assignment and coordinator wave baseline; no version bump is appropriate.

findings.assessment: The existing skill already provides the requested owner/invariant/alias/concurrency/durability boundaries and meaningful simpler alternatives. Complete inspection, targeted primary contracts and extracted-snippet controls did not justify an edit.

evidence.finding: Consumer operation, state ownership, overwrite policy and project toolchain precede the API decision. Owner-checked snapshots prepare replacements before publication; mutable isolation is required at capture and restore.
evidence.consequence: The skill already prevents foreign snapshots, retained-capture aliasing and unsupported all-or-nothing claims. Partial snippets explicitly retain domain validation obligations.

evidence.finding: Round trips use independent semantic observation; omitted fields and restore-introduced aliases receive distinct checks. History operations prepare before removing entries; no-op/rejected edits and redo/branch policies are separated.
evidence.consequence: Capture equality cannot hide a missing field, and a rejected restore must not silently consume undo history.

evidence.finding: Atomic reference publication is separated from read-modify-write semantics. ABA is explicitly covered with a non-restored generation compared and advanced together with state when the conflict policy requires it.
evidence.consequence: No need to add concurrency boilerplate; identity-only acceptance remains valid only for the stated weaker policy, not as proof that no intervening edit occurred.

evidence.finding: Immutable references, small bounded copies and exact inverses remain alternatives. Durable captures require schema/evolution semantics; restoring local state is explicitly distinct from compensation and irreversible effects.
evidence.consequence: Avoids forced event sourcing/persistent structures and prevents a restored flag from being treated as a reversal of an already durable external action.

evidence.finding: Checkpoint decoding is a qualified Jackson 2.x partial sketch checked against 2.17.3, with integral/range version checks, adapters, post-migration validation and bounded parsing obligations. Local transaction ownership is distinguished from remote effects.
evidence.consequence: No unsupported dependency upgrade or durable exactly-once guarantee is introduced.

preserved: Opaque caretaker contract and explicit distinction from a readable DTO, durable snapshot and authoritative event log.
Java 17 partial-snippet baseline without preview, plus inspection of the target project toolchain.

Independent semantic round-trip observation and no-op/rejected-edit versus successful-edit histories.
Small bounded copies or retained immutable references when adequate; measured retention instead of a universal depth-times-size heap bound.
Versioned checkpoint semantics, Jackson coercion/range guard, recovery completeness and external-effect boundaries.
Twelve existing declared optional skill referrals and conditionally routed references.

sources.section: Java SE 17 List: Unmodifiable Lists and copyOf
sources.supports: List structure is unmodifiable; mutable elements remain mutable.
Generated accessors and Object methods have observable component-based behavior; private nesting alone does not redact rendering.
Volatile publication has happens-before semantics; reference reads/writes are atomic, not multi-operation updates.
CAS compares expected reference identity; update callbacks may repeat and should be side-effect-free.
Reference and stamp can be compared/updated together; stamp advancement policy is application-owned.
Adding an edit after undo removes the abandoned redo suffix for this linear history contract.
An integer/range version guard avoids the coercions accepted by a bare int conversion.

sources.section: Microsoft Azure Architecture Center: Context and problem; Solution
sources.supports: External compensation is business-specific, can fail and cannot in general be replaced by restoring prior local state.

limitations: No measured agent improvement, baseline/final comparison, selection measurement or independent actor evaluation; unchanged package is a justified preservation decision.
JDK 17 API/source compilation target was checked with JDK 25; there was no execution on a JDK 17 runtime.
Twenty-four checks exercise three thread-confined originator snippets and deliberately ordered alias/ABA controls. They are not a linearizability proof, stress test or full application validation.

No jqwik generation, caretaker transaction implementation, Jackson integration, schema migration round trip, crash recovery, actual broker delivery, database transaction or memory benchmark was executed.
Source contracts support their specific Java/API properties. The Azure compensation discussion is design guidance, not proof of a particular business compensation operation.
Primary-source research was targeted, not a systematic pattern-literature review. No claim is made that all possible application invariants or formats were evaluated.
Some batched reading output was truncated; both supporting package references were subsequently read separately in full and primary contracts were inspected through targeted retrievals.
